pattern_explanation: Each Polish word shares its spelling with an English word through a different historical route, so the forms look alike while the meanings diverge. Students should check the meaning of each lookalike before translating it.
false_friend_warning: Each Polish word looks like an English word but means something different: aktualnie means currently, not actually; ewentualnie means possibly, not eventually; sympatyczny means nice, not sympathetic; and rewizja means a search or audit, not a revision of text.
